texts.Player King 在城堡大厅的长凳上躺下，佯装入睡。: Player King lies down on a bench in the castle hall, pretending to sleep.
texts.发现波洛涅斯尸体后，王后格特鲁德陷入沉默。: After discovering Polonius's body, Queen Gertrude falls silent.
texts.吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨暗中向波洛涅斯打听哈姆雷特的近况。: Guildenstern and Rosencrantz secretly inquire of Polonius about Hamlet's recent condition.
texts.吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨规定凡见哈姆雷特自言自语、激烈情绪或反常举动即向国王克劳: Guildenstern and Rosencrantz agree that whenever they see Hamlet talking to himself, showing strong emotion, or acting unusually, they will report it to King Claudius.
texts.吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨轮流跟踪哈姆雷特在走廊与城堡露台的行踪。: Guildenstern and Rosencrantz take turns following Hamlet in the corridors and on the castle terrace.
texts.哈姆雷特暂未离开厄耳锡诺城堡王后寝宫的案发现场。: Hamlet has not yet left the scene of the incident in the Queen's chamber of Elsinore Castle.
texts.国王克劳狄斯下令封锁厄耳锡诺城堡并彻查杀害波洛涅斯的凶手。: King Claudius orders Elsinore Castle locked down and commands a full investigation into the murderer of Polonius.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡的王后寝宫，波洛涅斯的尸体被发现。: Polonius's body is found in the Queen's chamber at Elsinore Castle.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨决定分头监视哈姆雷特。: At Elsinore Castle, Guildenstern and Rosencrantz decide to split up to watch Hamlet.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，吉尔登斯特恩被分配负责监视哈姆雷特的露台与外廊。: At Elsinore Castle, Guildenstern is assigned to watch Hamlet on the terrace and outer corridor.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，国王克劳狄斯命令罗森克兰茨与吉尔登斯特恩靠近哈姆雷特并密切监视哈: At Elsinore Castle, King Claudius orders Rosencrantz and Guildenstern to get close to Hamlet and closely watch Hamlet's expression and
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，国王克劳狄斯指示第一伶人演出一段包含“国王被暗害”桥段的戏，以试: At Elsinore Castle, King Claudius instructs the First Player to perform a play that includes a scene of 'the king being murdered' to test Hamlet's reaction.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，奥菲莉亚将假意接近哈姆雷特以试探他的举止和精神状态。: At Elsinore Castle, Ophelia will feign closeness to Hamlet to test his behavior and mental state.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，第一伶人向国王克劳狄斯报告，诸位演员已就位并将按原计划上演包含“: At Elsinore Castle, the First Player reports to King Claudius that the actors are in position and will perform the play including the 'king being murdered' scene as planned.
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，第一伶人向国王克劳狄斯说明，若哈姆雷特在观剧时有明显反应，演员们: At Elsinore Castle, the First Player tells King Claudius that if Hamlet shows a noticeable reaction during the play, the actors will immediately report to Claudius
texts.在厄耳锡诺城堡，罗森克兰茨被分配负责监视哈姆雷特的走廊与大厅。: At Elsinore Castle, Rosencrantz is assigned to watch Hamlet in the corridors and the hall.
texts.在厄耳锡诺，吉尔登斯特恩和罗森克兰茨分配监视哈姆雷特的职责：罗森克兰茨负责盯守城: At Elsinore, Guildenstern and Rosencrantz allocate duties to watch Hamlet: Rosencrantz is responsible for watching the castle's terrace and outer corridor
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus准备立刻排练首场新戏。: In the castle hall, Lucianus prepares to rehearse the first performance of the new play immediately.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus向霍拉旭承诺将原本的受害者改为虚构人物。: In the castle hall, Lucianus promises Horatio that the original victim will be changed to a fictional character.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus向霍拉旭承诺演出将全部采用无害且象征性的道具与表演。: In the castle hall, Lucianus assures Horatio that the performance will use only harmless, symbolic props and acting.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus向霍拉旭说明这个幕景是一个艺术设想。: In the castle hall, Lucianus explains to Horatio that the scene is an artistic concept.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus告诉霍拉旭该幕景的资助来自Lucianus私人资金。: In the castle hall, Lucianus tells Horatio that the scene is funded from Lucianus's private funds.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus指示舞台工作人员用无害着色剂在舞台上模拟毒药。: In the castle hall, Lucianus instructs the stagehands to simulate poison on stage using harmless dyes.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus指示霍拉旭分配演员分别扮演被害的侄儿、下毒者与旁观者: In the castle hall, Lucianus instructs Horatio to assign actors to play the murdered nephew, the poisoner, and a bystander.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus指示霍拉旭立即召集全部演员。: In the castle hall, Lucianus instructs Horatio to assemble all the actors immediately.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus表示愿意代为引荐伶后上台发言。: In the castle hall, Lucianus offers to introduce the Player Queen to speak on stage.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus要求在受害者倒地处留白三秒以观察剧团首席演员的反应。: In the castle hall, Lucianus requests a three-second pause where the victim falls to observe the reaction of the troupe's lead actor.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus询问霍拉旭是否愿意参与该幕景，或将该幕景的事宜禀报伶: In the castle hall, Lucianus asks Horatio whether he is willing to participate in the scene, or to report the matter to the Player King.
texts.在城堡大厅，Lucianus请霍拉旭担任該幕景的舞台安全与合规监督。: In the castle hall, Lucianus asks Horatio to act as the scene's stage safety and compliance supervisor.
texts.在城堡大厅，Player King命令卢西安纳斯如无解释则暂且缄默，不得发言。: In the castle hall, the Player King orders Lucianus to remain silent and not speak unless he has an explanation.
texts.在城堡大厅，Player King命令霍拉旭逐条陈述霍拉旭所怀疑之人、霍拉旭所见: In the castle hall, the Player King orders Horatio to state, item by item, the people Horatio suspects, the abnormal things Horatio has seen, and the reasons by which they can be verified.
texts.在城堡大厅，Player King嘱咐Player Queen在发表意见时措辞以: In the castle hall, the Player King instructs the Player Queen to phrase her remarks so as to soothe public sentiment and to prioritize preserving reconciliation within the court.
texts.在城堡大厅，伶王允准王后向群臣发表讲话，但要求先听霍拉旭向众人详陈其见。: In the castle hall, the Player King permits the Queen to address the courtiers but requires that Horatio first detail to everyone what he has seen.
texts.在城堡大厅，卢西安纳斯向霍拉旭提议在戏中安排以毒药毒死伶王侄儿的一幕，借此刺探伶: In the castle hall, Lucianus proposes to Horatio arranging a scene in the play in which the Player King's nephew is poisoned, in order to probe the Player King's reaction.
texts.在王后寝宫，哈姆雷特多次向王后格特鲁德质问，追问克劳狄乌斯是否谋害国王并隐瞒真相: In the Queen's chamber, Hamlet repeatedly questions Queen Gertrude, pressing whether Claudius murdered the king and concealed the truth.
texts.在王后寝宫，哈姆雷特要求格特鲁德发誓说明在哈姆雷特的父亲、已故国王死前她是否见过: In the Queen's chamber, Hamlet demands that Gertrude swear to say whether she had seen Claudius have contact with Hamlet's father, the late king, before his death.
texts.在王后寝宫，哈姆雷特要求王后格特鲁德以死者之名发誓。: In the Queen's chamber, Hamlet requires Queen Gertrude to swear by the name of the dead.
texts.奥菲莉亚在厄耳锡诺城堡的大厅听闻父亲波洛涅斯死讯后晕厥。: In the hall of Elsinore Castle, Ophelia faints upon hearing the news that her father Polonius is dead.
texts.王后格特鲁德再次否认知道波洛涅斯的尸体出现在王后寝宫。: Queen Gertrude again denies knowing that Polonius's body appeared in the Queen's chamber.
texts.王后格特鲁德再次否认自己与克劳狄乌斯合谋谋害国王。: Queen Gertrude again denies conspiring with Claudius to murder the king.
texts.罗森克兰茨、吉尔登斯特恩与奥菲莉亚约定若见哈姆雷特有异常举止立即向国王克劳狄斯报: Rosencrantz, Guildenstern, and Ophelia agree to report to King Claudius immediately if they see Hamlet behaving strangely.
texts.霍拉旭在城堡大厅向国王与群臣劝告，务必慎察近臣，勿轻信浮词。: In the castle hall, Horatio warns the King and the courtiers to be careful in examining close attendants and not to trust idle gossip.
texts.霍拉旭在城堡大厅向国王与群臣建议以公正与节制安抚民心，并表示愿意详陈他所见。: In the castle hall, Horatio advises the King and the courtiers to soothe the people with justice and moderation, and says he is willing to detail what he has seen.
texts.霍拉旭在城堡大厅向国王与群臣报告，称朝中风雨多端。: In the castle hall, Horatio reports to the King and the courtiers that the court is beset by turmoil.
texts.面对哈姆雷特的质问，王后格特鲁德保持沉默。: Faced with Hamlet's questioning, Queen Gertrude remains silent.
